variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders the word verbally, as a relative clause 'who should prophesy', which is the niphal participle of the qere הַנִּבְּאִים. The ketiv spelling הנביאים, with the yod, is the plural noun נְבִיאִים 'the prophets'; had the ASV followed it the phrase would name the men prophets rather than describe their service, as it does elsewhere in the verse ('set apart for the service ... certain of the sons of Asaph'). The wording therefore distinguishes the qere.
